parameters.name: log_disk_size
parameters.info: the size of disk space used by the log files. Range: [0, +∞)

parameters.name: cpu_count
parameters.info: the number of CPU\'s in the system. If this parameter is set to zero, the number will be set according to sysconf; otherwise, this parameter is used. Range: [0,+∞) in integer

parameters.name: memory_limit
parameters.info: deprecated compatibility parameter. The configured value is accepted and persisted, but is ignored by memory sizing and memory control. Range: 0, [1G,).

parameters.name: memory_budget
parameters.info: the logical memory budget used to size caches and buffers. 0 targets 80% of cgroup or physical memory while reserving at least 1G for the system when possible. The minimum automatic value is 1G. Range: 0, [1G,).

parameters.name: datafile_maxsize
parameters.info: the auto extend max size. Range: [0, +∞)

parameters.name: datafile_size
parameters.info: size of the data file. Range: [0, +∞)
